<?php

$teams = ['Lions', 'Tigers', 'Eagles', 'Sharks', 'Wolves', 'Bears'];
$records = array_fill_keys($teams, array_fill(0, 7, 0));
$matches = [
    'Lions 0-3 Bears', 'Tigers 2-2 Wolves', 'Eagles 4-0 Sharks', 'Bears 0-1 Sharks',
    'Wolves 2-1 Eagles', 'Lions 0-1 Tigers', 'Tigers 3-3 Bears', 'Eagles 2-2 Lions',
    'Sharks 2-2 Wolves', 'Bears 3-1 Wolves', 'Lions 2-0 Sharks', 'Tigers 2-1 Eagles',
    'Eagles 1-0 Bears', 'Sharks 2-0 Tigers', 'Wolves 2-1 Lions',
];
foreach ($matches as $match) {
    [$home, $score, $away] = explode(' ', $match);
    [$h, $a] = array_map('intval', explode('-', $score));
    foreach ([[$home, $h, $a], [$away, $a, $h]] as [$team, $gf, $ga]) {
        $records[$team][0]++;
        $records[$team][4] += $gf;
        $records[$team][5] += $ga;
        if ($gf > $ga) {
            $records[$team][1]++;
            $records[$team][6] += 3;
        } elseif ($gf === $ga) {
            $records[$team][2]++;
            $records[$team][6]++;
        } else {
            $records[$team][3]++;
        }
    }
}
usort($teams, function ($a, $b) use ($records) {
    $x = $records[$a];
    $y = $records[$b];
    return ($y[6] <=> $x[6]) ?: (($y[4] - $y[5]) <=> ($x[4] - $x[5])) ?: ($y[4] <=> $x[4]) ?: strcmp($a, $b);
});
foreach ($teams as $position => $team) {
    [$played, $wins, $draws, $losses, $gf, $ga, $points] = $records[$team];
    $difference = $gf - $ga;
    $signed = $difference > 0 ? '+' . $difference : (string) $difference;
    printf(
        "%d. %s P=%d W=%d D=%d L=%d GF=%d GA=%d GD=%s Pts=%d\n",
        $position + 1,
        $team,
        $played,
        $wins,
        $draws,
        $losses,
        $gf,
        $ga,
        $signed,
        $points,
    );
}
